what: EYES AND EARS -- E15 [machine judges] round 2. Step 0: where the queue actually is.

override_meter.why_not: no record stores, per cook, the MACHINE verdict beside the HUMAN verdict that followed it. Files that mention both mention them in prose, not as a pair a machine can compare. So the override rate cannot be computed today.
override_meter.the_one_line_that_would_fix_it: when a cook clears the machine pass, write its machine verdict into the same verdict record the human thumb lands in. One field, and the rate becomes a number forever after.

step_zero.lane: READ THIS FRONT PAGE EVERY SINGLE TIME YOU HEAR THE WORD VAMILY

premise_tested.the_premise: DIRECTION is the bottleneck because every cook waits on a human judgement

machine: Does it still READ at play size?
human: Does it belong to THIS world?
What would a stranger call it, in one word, for each picture?

coverage.evidence: every cooked tile lands inside the band measured off HIS art
coverage.why: the gate still carries the check

coverage.question: Same COLOUR DENSITY?
coverage.why: the gate still carries the check

coverage.evidence: keeps its value inside the card

coverage.question: Same GRAIN SCALE?
